description:
Quick-start examples in 4 client crate READMEs do not compile because they use a constructor signature that does not exist:

- crate-jmap-contacts-client/README.md: `JmapClient::new("https://…/.well-known/jmap")?`
- crate-jmap-sharing-client/README.md: same
- crate-jmap-tasks-client/README.md: `jmap_base_client::JmapClient::new(/* ... */)` (placeholder)
- crate-jmap-filenode-client/README.md: same placeholder

The actual constructor is `JmapClient::new(transport, auth, base_url, config)` or `JmapClient::new_plain(auth, base_url, config)`. The single-string-argument form has never existed in jmap-base-client.

A fifth crate has a different but equally broken example:
- crate-jmap-calendars-client/README.md uses `JmapClientBuilder::new().credential("user","secret").build()` and `client.fetch_session("https://…/.well-known/jmap")` — no `JmapClientBuilder` exists, and `fetch_session(url)` is not a method on `JmapClient`.

Fix: rewrite all 5 READMEs' quick-start examples using the actual API. Pin the example to a code snippet that is also a doc-test (`/// ```rust,no_run`) so future API changes break the build instead of silently rotting the README.
title: P1: 4 client READMEs use nonexistent JmapClient::new(string) signature; 1 uses fictional JmapClientBuilder
